title: Crispy American Tofu Skillet
description: A flavorful and protein-packed skillet dish made with crispy tofu, juicy vegetables, and a hint of American spices.
instructions: Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes.
Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat.
Add the cubed tofu to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the tofu from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat.
Add the sliced onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cooked tofu back to the skillet and stir in the American seasoning.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the crispy tofu skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
